reason: Most of my leads come from posting and comment-to-DM, and I only cold DM when the pipeline is thin, so I'm not paying $147 every month for a cold outreach tool I'd use a few weeks a quarter. And I've seen enough AI openers to know prospects can smell them.
objection: AI-written DMs sound robotic and prospects can tell. There are no customer results published, so I'd be the guinea pig, and I'd be putting my own Instagram account on the line for it.
would_change_my_mind: Real reply and booked-call numbers from agency owners like me, or a no-card trial where I can see a few drafts written for my actual niche and judge them myself.
